players.product: AI cloud infrastructure provider leasing HPC data-center capacity (TeraWulf Lake Mariner, Cipher Digital Barber Lake, Hut 8 River Bend; lead of the 168 MW Abernathy TX campus)

quarterly_data.signal: TeraWulf's July 6, 2026 release describes Fluidstack as its Abernathy joint venture partner and a leading AI cloud infrastructure provider. TeraWulf agreed to sell its entire 50.1% ownership interest in the Abernathy Joint Venture, established in 2025 to develop a 168 MW critical IT load AI data center campus in Abernathy, Texas, to an investor group led by Fluidstack, which will continue leading the project.
quarterly_data.figure: 50.1% JV interest sold to a Fluidstack-led group; 168 MW critical IT load campus
